screenshots.caption: The installed designer displays the authored board, exact avatar state and replay cursor. Recorded next actions are explicitly hindsight, rather than a bot forecast.
Five original generated matches use consecutive seeds and a 24-action cap. The displayed result is one red win and four draws; it does not evaluate the edited board.
